segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about git 工作区状态 with a teammate. I use working tree to talk about 工作树，当前检出的项目文件状态. I use staged change to talk about 已暂存改动，准备进入下一次提交的变化. I use unstaged change to talk about 未暂存改动，尚未加入提交区的变化. I tell my teammate: Today I use working tree, staged change, and unstaged change. At the end, I say: I can use working tree clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 租房和维修 with a teammate. I use The sink is leaking. to talk about 水槽漏水了。. I use The light isn't working. to talk about 灯不亮了。. I use Could someone repair it? to talk about 可以派人来修吗？. I tell my teammate: Today I use The sink is leaking., The light isn't working., and Could someone repair it?. At the end, I say: I can use The sink is leaking. clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 修改或撤销提交 with a teammate. I use amend a commit to talk about 修改最近提交，补充或更正最后一次提交. I use revert a commit to talk about 还原提交，用新提交抵消旧提交的改动. I use reset a branch to talk about 重置分支，把分支指针移到另一提交. I tell my teammate: Today I use amend a commit, revert a commit, and reset a branch. At the end, I say: I can use amend a commit clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 修改或撤销提交 with a teammate. I use discard changes to talk about 丢弃改动，放弃尚未保存的文件变化. I use restore a file to talk about 恢复文件，把文件恢复到指定状态. I use force push to talk about 强制推送，用本地历史覆盖远程分支历史. I tell my teammate: Today I use discard changes, restore a file, and force push. At the end, I say: I can use discard changes clearly today.
